name: Son Felip
description: An organic farm estate in northern Ciutadella, between Algaiarens and Cala Pilar, with an exclusive-use country house: you rent the whole place, with a pool among olive trees, an organic garden, purebred Menorcan horses and a private path down to Cala Pilar on the Camí de Cavalls. Starlight-certified for the quality of its night sky. Luxury here is literal: the entire estate to yourself.

practicalInfo.acceso: North of Ciutadella, Algaiarens area; directions on booking.
practicalInfo.horario: Exclusive use by reservation; check availability on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: Exclusive-use house, pool, organic garden, Menorcan horses, private path towards Cala Pilar, Starlight sky.
